\textbf{Solution:} Connect \textit{BC} as shown in the figure:\\
$\because$ $\angle ADC=30^\circ$,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle ABC=\angle ADC=30^\circ$,\\
$\because$ \textit{AB} is the diameter,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle ACB=90^\circ$,\\
$\because$ \textit{AC} $=5\text{cm}$,\\

$\therefore$ the radius of $\odot O$ is $\boxed{5}\text{cm}$;
